name: anticipatory-obstacle-transition-priority-v1
depends_on: guarded-distant-obstacle-preposition-v1 and guarded-distant-bend-preview-v1 synthetic and regression acceptance

scope.primary_change: neutralize only the controller's internal previous-steering value before inherited slew when the immediately preceding emitted action was exactly a registered distant preview and the current detected-obstacle steering proposal points in the opposite direction

control.base_source_commit: c5946ff plus the two already preregistered uncommitted candidate implementations

trigger.finding: After a +0.05 distant preview, an immediately detected obstacle requiring negative avoidance is slew-limited to -0.02, while the distant-obstacle control that emitted zero on the preview frame reaches -0.07. The mirrored transition has the same weakness.
trigger.risk: The pace-oriented preview can therefore weaken the first safety-critical avoidance action in exactly the transition most relevant to the Track 3 collision failure.

hypothesis.failure: The inherited 0.07 command slew treats the bounded preview as persistent steering history even when a newly detected obstacle requires an immediate opposing maneuver.
hypothesis.repair: Remember whether the actual prior emitted steering exactly reached the requested +/-0.05 distant preview. If and only if the next frame has a detected obstacle and the fully inherited obstacle-adjusted proposal opposes that prior preview, set the internal previous-steering value to zero before applying the unchanged sign gate and slew.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Restore the first opposing obstacle action to the distant-obstacle control magnitude without increasing any registered steering target, bypassing slew generally, or changing same-direction and non-obstacle transitions.

fixed.preview_marker: true only when the preceding frame requested distant preview and the final stored/emitted steering exactly equals that requested +/-0.05 value
fixed.transition_predicate: preview_marker=true AND current obstacle is detected AND inherited obstacle-adjusted steering proposal * previous steering < 0
fixed.state_action: set only internal previous steering to 0 immediately before the inherited final sign and slew logic

synthetic: For mirrored two-frame sequences of a qualifying distant bend followed by a straight obstacle requiring opposite avoidance, the candidate emits the same +/-0.05 preview as anticipatory control on frame one, then its complete frame-two action is bit-exact to the distant-obstacle controller and has greater avoidance magnitude than anticipatory control.
For mirrored preview-to-obstacle transitions whose avoidance agrees with the preview, every action and controller state is bit-exact to anticipatory control.

Preview-to-clear, preview-to-established-curve, ordinary obstacle, invalid-input, and reset sequences do not apply the neutralization and remain bit-exact to anticipatory control where their prior states match.
The marker clears after any non-preview emitted action and on reset.
Actions remain finite, bounded, slew-limited outside the single registered neutralization, deterministic after reset, and mutually exclusive in gas and brake.
regression: Every earlier stable, obstacle-preposition, and distant-bend-preview isolated contract remains valid.
Existing controller, inference, policy-routing, and package tests pass.
Bare state-dict routing selects a final obstacle-priority subclass while DrQ, explicit exports, and HAIC paths remain unchanged.

abort: The current obstacle steering target, speed target, gas, brake, detector, pass side, or perception changes.
The gate applies without an immediately preceding actually emitted preview, without a current detected obstacle, or when the proposal agrees with the prior preview.
A general slew increase, track-specific signal, second transition threshold, or direct action override is required.
Any frozen DrQ artifact, official environment file, reserved seed, model.pt, user video, or evidence ZIP changes.
Any relevant interface, package, or deterministic-reset test fails.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
No environment execution, safety improvement claim, submission, or SOTA promotion is authorized.
